name: Tryptophan-kynurenine catabolism and NAD+ biosynthesis
rationale: Members cover tryptophan/kynurenine/quinolinate catabolism feeding de novo NAD+ synthesis plus nicotinate salvage, NAD(P)+ synthesis/transport and redox; the tryptophan-kynurenine branch and NAD focus separate it from the polyamine and coenzyme A/pyruvate confusables.

qualifier: CpG islands, imprinting and facultative heterochromatin
name: DNA methylation-mediated gene silencing and imprinting
rationale: All members concern DNA methylation and the silencing it produces (CpG island methylation, PRC2, imprinting, facultative heterochromatin), unlike confusables centred on histone lysine/arginine methylation and chromatin remodellers.

qualifier: splice-isoform ligand binding and activating point mutants
name: FGFR1-3 isoform ligand binding and activating mutants
rationale: Members are FGFR1/2/3 b/c-isoform ligand binding, FGFR2 alternative splicing and oncogenic point mutants, i.e. receptor-level activation, whereas confusables are downstream FRS/SHC/PLC/PI3K cascades and FGFR4 mutants.

core: Definitive endoderm and lateral plate mesoderm formation
name: Definitive endoderm, lateral mesoderm and gut tube morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover endoderm specification, lateral plate mesoderm and mesenchyme migration, and foregut/hindgut/digestive tract morphogenesis, distinguishing the theme from confusables about gastrulation, primitive streak and pluripotency.

name: Negative control of kidney progenitor proliferation
rationale: Members concern proliferation in metanephric/kidney development and its negative regulation, including restraint of somatic stem cell maintenance, whereas confusables focus on kidney size, mesenchymal apoptosis, ureter and nephron differentiation.

name: Neural progenitor division and midbrain dopaminergic neuron differentiation
rationale: Members cover neuroblast/radial glia/ventricular zone progenitor proliferation and asymmetric division plus midbrain dopaminergic neuron differentiation, which confusables (cortical migration, noradrenergic, cerebellar, pituitary) lack.

qualifier: receptor uptake and cofactor processing defects
name: Cellular cobalamin uptake and processing disorders
rationale: Members are cobalamin metabolism and its inherited defects in cellular uptake (CD320) and intracellular processing (MMACHC, MMADHC), distinct from confusables on dietary/plasma cobalamin transport and methylmalonyl-CoA mutase defects.

name: Tyrosine kinase inhibitor resistance of KIT mutants
rationale: Every member is KIT mutant binding of or resistance to a TKI, distinguishing it from PDGFR and FLT3 TKI-resistance themes and from KIT mutant signalling.

name: BDNF and NT-3 signaling through TrkB and TrkC
rationale: Members are NTRK2/NTRK3 activation by BDNF, NT-3 and NT-4 and their PI3K, RAS, PLCG1, FRS and CDK5 effectors, whereas confusables cover NGF/TrkA signalling.

name: Heavy metal response and metallothionein detoxification
rationale: Members are responses to zinc, copper, manganese, cadmium, lead, mercury, cobalt and selenium with MTF1 and metallothionein detoxification, unlike confusables on zinc/copper transport homeostasis or reactive oxygen species.

qualifier: membrane tubulation, vesicle budding and docking
name: Membrane tubulation and vesicle budding in intracellular transport
rationale: Members concern generic membrane traffic with emphasis on membrane/endosome tubulation, Golgi vesicle budding and membrane docking, whereas confusables are specific Golgi/ER secretory, Rab GTPase or recycling routes.

name: Translation initiation and its regulation by cellular stress
rationale: Members cover ternary/43S complex formation, scanning, 60S joining and eIF2 recycling plus GCN2- and ER-stress control of translation, which confusables (termination, NMD, ribosome rescue, RNA polymerase I/III) lack.

core: Viral attachment and entry into host cells
name: Viral attachment, entry and fusion with host cells
rationale: Members are virion attachment, receptor-mediated endocytosis, fusion and entry of dengue, RSV, influenza and HIV, distinct from confusables on host suppression of viruses and viral protein maturation.

qualifier: regulation of intrinsic apoptosis and p21-mediated G1 arrest
name: Regulation of p53 apoptotic and G1-arrest responses to DNA damage
rationale: Members regulate p53 expression, cofactors and signalling toward intrinsic apoptosis and p21/G1 arrest, whereas confusables cover p53 transcription of death-receptor/caspase genes or radiation and senescence responses.

name: Renal epithelial polarity, brush border and podocyte development
rationale: Members combine apical/basal polarity, microvillus/brush border assembly and podocyte/glomerular epithelium (nephrin, basement membrane, albumin absorption), separating it from glomerular endothelium/mesangium and generic epithelial adhesion confusables.

qualifier: HNF4/CDX-driven absorptive lineage and stem cell renewal
name: Intestinal absorptive epithelium identity and renewal
rationale: Nearly all members describe HNF4/CDX-specified intestinal absorptive epithelium, its development and stem cell homeostasis (leukocyte migration is an outlier), unlike confusables on defensins, melanocytes or keratinocytes.

name: Telomeric chromatin packaging that suppresses recombination
rationale: Members concern telomere packaging, subtelomeric heterochromatin and ATRX/DAXX inhibition of telomeric recombination with telomerase restraint, whereas confusables cover recombination-based maintenance, capping and C-strand synthesis.

name: Retinal neuron development and photoreceptor phototransduction
rationale: Members cover photoreceptor, bipolar and amacrine differentiation, outer segment organization and the phototransduction cascade, unlike confusables on the retinoid cycle/opsins or anterior eye and optic cup morphogenesis.

name: LXR-linked triglyceride and fatty acid homeostasis
rationale: Members regulate triglyceride synthesis, storage and fatty acid homeostasis including LXR (NR1H2/3) target programs, distinguishing it from PPARA, glucagon/PKA, adipogenesis and SREBP confusables.

name: Chromosome condensation and centromeric CENP-A chromatin assembly
rationale: Members cover mitotic/meiotic chromosome condensation and nucleosome/CENP-A chromatin assembly, distinct from confusables on sister chromatid cohesion and histone acetylation.

name: RNA polymerase III initiation at type 1 and 2 promoters
rationale: All members are Pol III initiation at type 1/2 (5S and tRNA) promoters, whereas confusables include Pol III elongation/termination, type 3 snRNA promoters and Pol I rRNA transcription.

name: Keratinocyte differentiation, cornification and epidermal barrier formation
rationale: Members are interfollicular keratinocyte proliferation/differentiation, cornified envelope assembly and skin barrier formation, distinct from wound healing, hair follicle/ectodermal appendage and melanocyte confusables.

name: Non-mitochondrial RNA methylation, pseudouridylation and Cajal body targeting
rationale: Members are rRNA/tRNA/mRNA/snRNA base modification, snoRNP assembly and scaRNA/telomerase RNA localization to Cajal bodies, unlike mitochondrial RNA modification and pre-rRNA cleavage confusables.

name: Monocyte chemotaxis and activation in inflammatory cytokine response
rationale: Members regulate monocyte chemotaxis, extravasation, aggregation and MCP-1 production within inflammatory cytokine programs (incl. RAGE signalling), which confusables on generic migration, CCR2/CX3CR1 signatures or endothelial adhesion lack.

name: CCR2/CX3CR1 monocyte-macrophage recruitment and danger-ligand sensing
rationale: Members cover monocyte/macrophage chemotaxis and MCP-1 control with CCR2/CX3CR1 modules plus RAGE, class B scavenger and endogenous TLR ligand sensing, unlike monocyte surface signature, chemokine-cluster and endothelial adhesion confusables.
